title: International RSE Survey 2026 — Germany
text:
Survey overview
This book presents the 2026 survey independently for Germany, using the questions and answer options stored in that year’s export.
Country scope: Germany
Source records: 1164
Records matching country scope: 266
Respondents included: 266
Question groups discovered: 69
Submitted and partial records are included. Each question uses only records with a recorded answer to that question.
Only respondents whose socio1_0 value is Germany are included.
No cross-year harmonisation is applied.
Submitted records: 206
Partial records: 60
